instruction: Add all my coworkers and roommates as friends on venmo, if they are not already.
notes: The contacts are unknown up front, so coworker-1/2 and roommate-1/2 are placeholder persons (declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can reference them); at runtime one placeholder stands for every contact returned by phone.search_contacts for the given relationship, and the static has-relation/contact-email facts are the structure filled by the search response. phone.show_contact_relationships is included so the exact relationship strings used by the phone app are read at runtime rather than guessed. The 'if not already friends' clause is modelled by venmo.show_profile(email) which reveals friendship status (friendship-checked); venmo.add_friend requires that check and (not (is-friend ?p)). Since the initial state cannot assert which contacts are already friends, the reference plan adds every placeholder; at runtime the agent skips contacts whose profile already shows them as friends (satisfying is-friend without an add_friend call), which matches the evaluation requiring only new friendships for the coworker/roommate venmo users and no deletions. complete_task takes no answer.
